citation.authors: Potočnik MM, Edwards I, Potočnik N
citation.title: Locomotor–Respiratory Entrainment upon Phonated Compared to Spontaneous Breathing during Submaximal Exercise
citation.journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health

reported.what: respiratory rate averaged over the 5-min constant-load cycling bout (its last three minutes analysed), pooled over the participants, mean ± SD, for each of the three breathing patterns (BrP1 spontaneous, BrP2 phonated 'h', BrP3 phonated 'ss'); n = 26, the number implied by the printed counts of 13 (50%) and 11 (42%) entrained participants

location.quote: The average RR (18.8 ± 5.0) at BrP2 was lower compared to BrP1 (22.6 ± 5.5) and BrP3 (21.3 ± 7.2)

detail: The bout is a 'predetermined load' 'below the GET' (Methods 2.2), and the paper prints neither its watts nor a %VO2max nor a VO2 for the pooled group: Table 2 gives measured VO2/kg only for nine breathing-by-entrainment cells, and picking one or averaging them is not a derivation the format allows, so the bout's level cannot be written; the resting values, which need no bout, are not printed (Table 1 holds test statistics only, Table 2 is exercise).
